title: What is Async Await?
overview: Async and await are modern JavaScript features used to handle asynchronous operations. They make asynchronous code easier to read and write compared to Promise chaining.

example.title: Async Await Example

title: async Keyword
overview: The async keyword is used before a function to make it return a Promise automatically. It allows the use of await inside that function.

title: await Keyword
overview: The await keyword pauses the execution of an async function until a Promise is resolved. It allows asynchronous code to look like synchronous code.

example.title: await Example

title: Error Handling with try catch
overview: try...catch is used with async await to handle errors that may occur during asynchronous operations.

example.title: try catch Example

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how async and await simplify asynchronous JavaScript, how to use async functions, await Promises, and handle errors using try...catch.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ async creates Promise-based functions.
✔ await waits for Promise results.
✔ Makes async code easier to read.
✔ try...catch handles errors.
